name: Garudoma -Joshiryou no Kanrinin-
original_name: ガルドマ -女子寮の管理人-
source:
"I'm experiencing the harem life in a prestigious all-girls' school's dormitory?!"

Haruto has been caught in a conflicting situation. His acquaintance had recommended him a job  which also involved him living there at the same time, and he decided to apply for it, without actually telling Haruto that the job was being the manager of a prestigious all-girls' school's dormitory.

While doing his best to not screw up, he ends up becoming closer with three particular girls.
Natsumi Rin, who acts quite cynical when around Haruto.
Akishima Hiyori, a cat-like girl who enjoys teasing and pranking Haruto.
And Fuyusaki Aiko, a girl who always seems to have a yearning gaze while looking at Haruto.

Then all of a sudden, he gets into a sexual relationship with all three of them. The story of the three girls who live in the girls' dormitory starts rolling in an unexpected direction.

[From [url=http://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/garudoma/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
「我竟然要在名門女子學校的宿舍裡，過上後宮生活？！」

春人陷入了進退兩難的境地。熟人向他介紹了一份包住的工作，他便決定去應徵，事前卻沒人告訴他，這份工作竟是擔任名門女子學校的宿舍管理員。

為了不出差錯，他竭盡全力，卻在不知不覺間與三名女孩拉近了距離。
面對春人時總是冷嘲熱諷的夏海鈴。
像貓一樣，喜歡捉弄春人、對他惡作劇的秋島日和。
以及看向春人時，目光中總是彷彿帶著渴求的冬咲藍子。

隨後，他突然與三人都發生了性關係。住在女生宿舍裡的三名女孩，她們的故事開始朝著意想不到的方向發展。

（摘自[url=http://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/garudoma/story.html]官方網站[/url]）
